scope: Only arithmetic on already-selected, same-population totals. This is not a complete dashboard business contract.
preconditions: Caller selects one account, explicit closed date range and CURRENT evidence versions only.
Caller includes only spend > 0 material-day rows, per D-028.
Numerator and denominator use the same rows and date range. Never average source daily rates.
Unknown source fields are not converted to zero and cannot silently be omitted from a complete total.
Coverage metadata remains separate and mandatory at query integration. A computable partial value is not complete coverage.

engineeringChoices.decimalMath: BigDecimal, exact multiplication/subtraction, MathContext.DECIMAL128 for division; no double and no early display rounding

valueStatus.VALID: Numeric value is available; zero numerator with positive denominator is real zero. Does not imply complete coverage.
valueStatus.UNKNOWN_INPUT: A required operand is unknown; value is null. Null is allowed only with this explicit state, never as an ambiguous result.
valueStatus.ZERO_DENOMINATOR: All operands are known but denominator is zero; value is null, not zero/Infinity/NaN.

engineeringChoices.unavailableDisplay: An em dash with the corresponding reason; no #DIV/0! or fabricated 0%
engineeringChoices.precedence: UNKNOWN_INPUT before ZERO_DENOMINATOR if any operand is unknown

notAuthorizedByThisContract: Choosing annual/lifetime ROI periods, initial-date semantics or trend rules
Database writes, APIs, UI changes, collectors, cloud deployment or public access
